title: Reduce duplication in website surface card styles
description: The website still has repeated border, radius, hover, and inset-accent surface treatments spread across `website/src/styles/game-list.css`, `website/src/styles/game-viewer.css`, `website/src/pages/season/[season]/results.astro`, and related components. Survey those card-like surfaces, rank the repeated patterns, and consolidate the highest-value one into a shared CSS primitive instead of copy-pasting variants.
